## Cloud answer (cloud#3334 item 3): it did NOT reach the Console — fixed in objectstack-ai/cloud#3339

**Premise:** `69aa630b9f` (PR #26281) is an ancestor of cloud's pin `6390fe52`.

**What cloud had:** both planes mount the Console through `mountConsoleStatic`, which starts `createConsoleStaticPlugin` on a shim ctx whose `getService` answered only `http.server` ([`packages/objectos-runtime/src/node-server.ts` at main](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/a32c80cc/packages/objectos-runtime/src/node-server.ts#L98)). On objectos the host app has no `storage` service anyway: `StorageServicePlugin` is mounted on each environment's own kernel by the capability loader. So `readStorageUploadOrigin` got `undefined` and the hosted CSP named no store — the second branch this card describes.

**Fix (objectstack-ai/cloud#3339):** the shim now answers `storage` ([`node-server.ts:118`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/objectos-runtime/src/node-server.ts#L118)):
- objectos: `consoleUploadOriginSource()` ([`console-upload-origin.ts:74`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/objectos-runtime/src/console-upload-origin.ts#L74)), a framework `S3StorageAdapter` over the plane's one attachment bucket (`OS_STORAGE_S3_*`, the same `resolveTenantAttachmentBucket` reading the kernel factory uses; only the key prefix differs per environment, which never moves the host). Its `getPresignedUploadOrigin()` names the origin, so it matches the presigned URL exactly.
- control plane: its own kernel's `storage` service ([`apps/cloud/server/index.ts:282`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/apps/cloud/server/index.ts#L282)).
- Test: [`node-server.console-upload-origin.test.ts`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/b060341f/packages/objectos-runtime/src/node-server.console-upload-origin.test.ts) serves a staged Console through the real CLI plugin and reads `connect-src`; the R2 virtual-hosted and path-style origins come from the real adapter. Red with the shim's `storage` answer removed.

**Stop-gap:** `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC` appears in no cloud file (`wrangler.toml`, `.github/workflows/**`), so dropping it is not a Tier H edit: if it is set on a plane, it was set by hand as a Worker var/secret and is removed there. ⛔ Only after the hosted read this card names passes on that plane (document `connect-src` names `https://BUCKET.ACCOUNT.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`; presign → PUT → complete → download in the browser), once #3339 is deployed.
